"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
caption_embedding.py - Embed caption chunks for semantic meeting search
live_caption_safety.py - Check live transcript text for unsafe content
live_caption_translate.py - Translate live captions into another language
meeting_summary.py - Summarize live meeting transcript chunks
partial_results.py - handles partial and final streaming recognition events
speech_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Streaming Speech-to-Text
speech_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Streaming Speech-to-Text
stream_chunks.py - streams audio chunks from an async source
stream_microphone.py - streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts
stream_with_language.py - starts a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings

Create stream_microphone.py in the current working directory.
Task: streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: stream_microphone.py
+import os
+import queue
+from typing import Generator, Optional
+
+import pyaudio
+from google.cloud import speech
+
+
+RATE = 16000
+CHUNK = int(RATE / 10)
+
+
+def _requests(audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]") -> Generator[speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest, None, None]:
+    while True:
+        chunk = audio_q.get()
+        if chunk is None:
+            return
+        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+
+
+def stream_microphone() -> Generator[str, None, None]:
+    client = speech.SpeechClient()
+    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+        sample_rate_hertz=RATE,
+        language_code=os.getenv("SPEECH_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en-US"),
+        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
+        model=os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_MODEL", "latest_long"),
+    )
+    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+        config=config,
+        interim_results=True,
+        single_utterance=False,
+    )
+
+    audio_q: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]" = queue.Queue()
+    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    stream = pa.open(
+        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+        channels=1,
+        rate=RATE,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        for _ in range(3):
+            audio_q.put(stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False))
+        responses = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, _requests(audio_q))
+        for response in responses:
+            for result in response.results:
+                if result.alternatives:
+                    yield result.alternatives[0].transcript
+    finally:
+        audio_q.put(None)
+        stream.stop_stream()
+        stream.close()
+        pa.terminate()
+
*** End Patch
